Accelerating Gemma 4: faster inference with multi-token prediction drafters ⭐️ 8.0/10

Google introduces Gemma 4 with multi-token prediction drafters to accelerate inference through speculative decoding, achieving faster generation without quality degradation.

标签: #speculative-decoding, #llm-inference, #gemma-4

Rowhammer Attack Against NVIDIA Chips ⭐️ 8.0/10

Two independent research teams demonstrated Rowhammer attacks on NVIDIA Ampere GPUs that achieve full system compromise by exploiting GDDR memory bitflips to gain control of CPU memory when IOMMU is disabled.

来源: Schneier on Security · May 6

标签: #security, #rowhammer, #gpu, #nvidia

2.5x faster inference with Qwen 3.6 27B using MTP ⭐️ 8.0/10

llama.cpp PR enables Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) for Qwen 3.6, delivering 2.5x faster inference and making 27B parameter models viable for local agentic coding on consumer GPUs with 262k context support.

来源: Reddit r/LocalLLaMA · May 6

标签: #llama.cpp, #Qwen, #speculative-decoding

Bleeding Llama: Critical Unauthenticated Memory Leak in Ollama ⭐️ 8.0/10

Critical unauthenticated memory leak vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) discovered in Ollama allowing attackers to extract sensitive data including model system prompts, API keys, and chat history via repeated /api/ps calls.

来源: Reddit r/LocalLLaMA · May 6

标签: #security, #ollama, #local-llm

Anthropic commits $200 billion to Google Cloud over five years for AI compute, alongside a potential $40 billion investment from Alphabet at $350B valuation, cementing one of the largest cloud-AI partnerships in history.

来源: The Information · May 6

标签: #AI infrastructure, #cloud computing, #Anthropic

苹果计划开放第三方 AI 模型选择 ⭐️ 8.0/10

Apple plans to open Apple Intelligence to third-party AI models in iOS 27, ending ChatGPT exclusivity and allowing users to choose between Google, Anthropic, and other providers for system-wide AI features.

来源: Bloomberg · May 6

标签: #apple-intelligence, #ai-platforms, #open-ecosystem
